I kindly request your assistance in reviewing my account activity and providing corrected invoices or receipts for the aforementioned transactions. Please let me know if you require any additional documentation or clarification from my side.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to resolving these discrepancies as soon as possible.

Best regards,
